snippet.title: URLX Custom Level: My Superhero Movie
snippet.description:
0/10, needs more SM64 characters

Download: https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/678284893142384709/971686740823781406/it_would_be_so_awesome.urlzip

If you haven't heard of URLX, it's a rhythm game made by GD Colon that is played in your browser's address bar (as you could probably tell). You can play it here: https://gdcolon.com/urlx

Here's a list of the controls so you can tell what's going on:

👆👇👈👉 - Arrow keys
🤙 - Up + Down
👐 - Left + Right
🡼🡽🡿🡾 - Up + Left, Up + Right, etc
👏 - Space
💣 - Get your hands off of the keyboard right now
(There's also 👊🏻 and ✌🏻 but I didn't use them)
